claims.subject: Pickpocketing
claims.value: stunned 9 ticks (cannot pickpocket for 8); NPC may be pickpocketed every 2 ticks
claims.statement: A failed pickpocket damages and stuns the player (9 ticks movement, 8 ticks no pickpocketing); eating while stunned adds the food delay. Successful pickpockets can be repeated every 2 ticks.

sources.quote: NPCs may be pickpocketed every two ticks (1.2 seconds).

sources.title: Thieving
sources.quote: Being stunned prevents the player from moving for nine ticks (5.4 seconds), and from further pickpocketing for eight ticks (4.8s).

sources.title: Thieving training
sources.quote: [[Gloves of silence]] increase players' success rate while pickpocketing by 5% while they are equipped. Wearing them requires level 54 [[Hunter]].

sources.title: Thieving training
sources.quote: The [[Ardougne Diary]] perks override the gloves of silence 5% success rate.

sources.title: Thieving training

claims.subject: Dodgy necklace
claims.value: 25% chance to avoid stun and damage on a failed pickpocket; 10 charges, 1 per prevented hit
claims.statement: Dodgy necklace gives a 25% chance to avoid being stunned and damaged on a failed pickpocket. It starts with 10 charges; one charge is used each time it prevents damage and it crumbles after the last. Charges are per player. GE item name: "Dodgy necklace".

sources.title: Dodgy necklace
sources.quote: While equipped, the necklace provides a 25% chance to prevent the player from being [[Stun (status)|stunned]] and damaged while [[pickpocketing]] [[NPC]]s. The necklace begins with 10 charges; one charge is consumed each time the necklace successfully prevents damage.

claims.subject: Shadow Veil
claims.value: 15% chance to avoid stun/damage; stacks with dodgy necklace for 36.25%; Magic 47 (Arceuus)

sources.title: Thieving training
sources.quote: While under the effects of the [[Shadow Veil]] spell, players have a 15% chance to avoid being [[Stun (status)|stunned]] and damaged while [[pickpocketing]] [[NPC]]s. claims.value: 30,000-50,000 XP/h at levels 1-45 (assumes rerolling raids until the first room is a thieving room)
claims.statement: Levels 1-45: loot chests in the CoX thieving room for an estimated 30,000-50,000 XP/h (scaled raids up to 100 players speed respawns); needs a lockpick; do not put grubs in the trough. sources.title: Thieving training
sources.quote: Steal from 4 chests in a circular motion and you can expect experience rates of up to 30,000–50,000 experience an hour.

sources.title: Thieving training
sources.quote: It only requires about one hour of raid time to level from 1-40.

claims.notes: Threat Analyst to rate: a raid death is run-ending on Hardcore Worlds per F-6002; thieving-room-only play avoids monsters but the raid environment is the hazard. Needs access via Kebos Lowlands.

claims.subject: Aldarin Villas chests
claims.statement: Levels 36-45: six chests upstairs in Aldarin villas give 200 XP per success at 1.8 s respawn; 40,000-50,000 XP/h is likely (60,000 max) with a lockpick and stamina/super energy potions, about 40,000 without. Failures can teleport the player out; the western villa has the shortest run back. At level 60 about 400 chests/h (80,000 XP/h).

sources.title: Thieving training
sources.quote: Each chest gives 200 experience per successful unlock. There is a chance on failure to be teleported outside.

sources.title: Thieving training
sources.quote: Up to 60,000 experience can be earned per hour even at lower levels, but 40,000–50,000 is more likely.

sources.title: Chest (Aldarin Villas)
sources.quote: They require 36 [[Thieving]] to unlock, and reward 200 [[experience]] on a successful attempt.

claims.notes: Loot: uncut gems, herb seeds, medium clue scrolls, blessed bone shards. Quest requirement field is "No" on the chest page. Access: Quetzal Transport System, Pendant of Ates, house portal etc. (Aldarin page); owner has Children of the Sun.

claims.statement: Pyramid Plunder gives about 125,000 XP/h at 71-80, 190,000 at 81-90 and 270,000 at 91+ assuming soloing with a pharaoh's sceptre teleport; about 335 games take you from 91 to 99; the wiki page gives 120,000 at 71 and over 275,000 at 91+ in the best case.

claims.notes: Duo or alt account gives higher rates. Do not bank artefacts (not valuable).

claims.subject: Pyramid Plunder
claims.value: Saradomin brews, stamina potions, antipoison (or serpentine helm); pharaoh's sceptre recharged with noted golden artefacts; sceptre drops from golden chests
claims.statement: Bring high-healing food (Saradomin brews), stamina potions and antipoison (araxyte venom sac or serpentine helm for poison immunity). A charged pharaoh's sceptre teleports to Jalsavrah; recharge with noted artefacts; desert diary raises charge cap. The sceptre is only found in Pyramid Plunder and can be sold. GE items: "Pharaoh's sceptre", "Saradomin brew(4)", "Stamina potion(4)".

claims.notes: Scarab swarms eat 10 Zulrah's scales with a serpentine helm. HW death rule for Pyramid Plunder is not in the carryover; Threat Analyst.

claims.subject: Rogues' Den wall safes
claims.statement: Rogues' Den lobby wall safes need 50 Thieving, give 70 XP and 20/40 coins or uncut gems up to diamond, with 2-6 stun damage on failure; a stethoscope helps. Cracking safes also yields the rogue outfit crate. Martin Thwait's shop needs 50 Thieving and 50 Agility (or 99 Thieving).

claims.subject: Rogues' Castle chests
claims.value: 84 Thieving; Wilderness levels 52-56 (chests at ~54); 3 chests, 20.4 s respawn; Search for traps first
claims.statement: Rogues' Castle chests need 84 Thieving, give 701.7 XP and respawn in 20.4 s (three chests). The castle is in the deep Wilderness (levels 52-56, chests at about 54). You must Search for traps before opening, and the rogues (level 135, max hit 15, Protect from Melee blocks) attack when a chest is looted. The Chaos Elemental may wander to the entrance.

sources.title: Chest (Rogues' Castle)
sources.quote: They require 84 [[Thieving]] to open. Players must use the "Search for traps" option from the right-click menu to open it successfully.

sources.quote: |wilderness = 52-56

sources.title: Chest (Rogues' Castle)
sources.quote: The rogues are moderately accurate and have a max hit of 15, but their damage can be completely blocked by [[Protect from Melee]].

claims.notes: Wilderness level 52-56. The page says PKers are extremely common; wiki notes dying to rogues drops items to the gravestone. On Hardcore Worlds (F-6001 Hardcore Group Ironman death rules) a death here would be run-ending, and F-6180 says escape crystals work only up to level 30 Wilderness. Threat Analyst to rate. Not assumed to be usable for the plan.
